events.description: The visitor passes a decorated Christmas tree and approaches a brightly lit wall display of historic firearms.
The visitor slowly examines a wall case containing mounted long guns, open presentation cases, photographs, labels, and a large curved tusk.
The visitor backs away from the wall case and moves past an information kiosk toward a freestanding display.
The visitor studies a sloped glass cabinet filled with antique pistols and accessories arranged in ornate fitted cases.
The visitor turns across the gallery and relocates to an adjacent freestanding cabinet.
The visitor examines another illuminated cabinet containing cased revolvers, loose long-barreled handguns, ammunition, and a small coffin-shaped pistol case.
The visitor inspects a neighboring cabinet holding a long gun in a metal case, several green and gray pistol cases, loose mechanical parts, photographs, and labels.
The visitor pauses at a separate display featuring gold-accented firearms, long barrels, presentation pieces, and a historical photograph.
The visitor walks around and examines an Olympiad-themed glass enclosure containing mounted rifles and pistols, documents, a digital panel, and a tan blazer on a mannequin.
The visitor turns back through the gallery toward a tall glass rack densely filled with long guns.
The visitor examines rows of rifles and shotguns mounted inside the tall glass rack, including open presentation cases along its base.
The visitor moves across the gallery past central cabinets and the Christmas tree toward a wall display labeled “Holland & Holland.”
The visitor closely surveys the Holland & Holland wall case, viewing mounted long guns and numerous open presentation cases with firearms, ammunition, photographs, and documents.
The visitor leaves the wall case and approaches a large central glass island displaying handguns.
The visitor circles and studies the central handgun display, first viewing cased revolvers on the lower shelf and then rows of pistols and revolvers on the raised upper shelf.
The visitor turns away from the handgun island and surveys the adjacent gallery and wall-mounted firearm displays.
